sections.text: Selpercatinib is US-approved for adults with locally advanced or metastatic RET-fusion-positive NSCLC. From age 2 years, separate indications cover advanced RET-fusion-positive thyroid cancer requiring systemic therapy and radioactive-iodine-refractory disease when appropriate, and other advanced RET-fusion-positive solid tumors after prior treatment or without satisfactory alternatives.

report_comment.text: KIF5B encodes a kinesin motor protein that transports cargo along microtubules. RET encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase activated by GDNF-family ligands and their coreceptors. The fusion joins an amino-terminal oligomerization region to the RET tyrosine-kinase domain, enabling ligand-independent signaling. KIF5B::RET is a recurrent lung adenocarcinoma driver. Selpercatinib is US-approved for adults with locally advanced or metastatic RET-fusion-positive NSCLC. From age 2 years, separate indications cover advanced RET-fusion-positive thyroid cancer requiring systemic therapy and radioactive-iodine-refractory disease when appropriate, and other advanced RET-fusion-positive solid tumors after prior treatment or without satisfactory alternatives.
